intermediate_observations: New browser selector initially matched Next route-announcer alert as well as login error; narrowed to the actual login component without changing assertion.
New pagination test initially captured old rows before the new API response committed; now asserts exact API page shipment IDs before changing language.
A broad translated template preceded a more specific remaining-hours template; production matcher now sorts literal specificity, with new exact label assertion.
Unpaced 36-page business crawl correctly hit unchanged180/min budget with429; acceptance crawl now paces below existing budgets, no API limit changes.
Text-node review found English KPI-definition labels and template link labels; translated their display labels explicitly, without changing schema keys.
Mobile screenshot showed cramped breadcrumb/account text; removed redundant mobile breadcrumb prefix and preserved single-line page title/logout.

Demo crawl exposed a genuine client burst: session is followed by datasets/workspace/exceptions reads; the third could exceed server2 concurrent operations despite fewer than120 requests. Frontend GET serialization now keeps server limits intact; added queue, abort, error recovery and unchanged-write assertions.

Controlled assumption notes need verbatim unknown text: preserved whitespace/newlines in translator fallback, and used exact-only catalog lookup for editable default notes and evidence basis to avoid generic templates translating user prose. Added exact whitespace/pattern-like prose assertions and browser request payload equality.
